title: Allow pre-role computation while keeping the actual post-role common-map boundary
statement: Arbitrary finite pre-role computation, runtime/public candidate records and pre-role aborts can be conditioned on before a fresh private role. They may destroy yield without invalidating soundness. The actual source/noise evolution must still be common to learn and service AFTER that boundary: merely hiding a classical role label does not neutralize role-dependent preparation duration. No extra payload measurement/leakage is licensed.
